## Summary

## Scope
- [ ] Backend / solver
- [ ] Frontend / accessibility
- [ ] Import / export
- [ ] Documentation / packaging

## Verification
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] `python -m compileall -q backend run_app.py`
- [ ] JavaScript syntax checks (when frontend code changes)
- [ ] Manual workflow test or screenshots (when UI changes)
- [ ] Solver assumptions and limitations documented (when solver changes)

## Data and security
- [ ] No secrets, private data, SQLite database, or local uploads committed
- [ ] No new external network dependency at runtime unless documented
